development_notes: Initial invocation without --all-features failed its unmutated baseline because feature-gated retention_probe has no crate-level documentation when disabled; no mutations from that invocation are counted.

First complete development run: 199 tested, 142 caught, 39 unviable, 6 timeouts, 12 survived. Added pending-journal, old-token, fresh-overlay cancellation/retry, finished-private-candidate, worker-width and no-op lifecycle tests. Removed redundant status-pending guard and simplified waiting/error translation.
Next complete run: 197 tested, 150 caught, 40 unviable, 6 timeouts, 1 survived (foreground discovery/watch registration). Added real-watcher new-directory test with a 60-second recovery interval.

A shutdown assertion first failed, then shutdown was changed to clear running recovery metadata after joining. Full host scope rerun after final changes: 44 tested, 28 caught, 15 unviable, 1 timeout, no survivors.
Final aggregate uses only application/engine/invalidation outcomes from the complete four-file run and host outcomes from the final complete host run; no duplicate host outcomes. No new exclusions.
limitations: Timeouts are separate from assertion catches: desired/plan cancellation mutations and no-result refreshes prevent bootstrap progress; inverted initial publication also loops.
Unviable substitutions are build failures, not behavioral detection.

Full affected native modules were covered, not just changed lines. Grammar/dependency internals, serialization macro bodies, OS event delivery, browser execution, and performance driver logic are outside this mutation scope.
